subject: Replay the same finance/shell question across two information frontiers without future leakage

body.text: Connect the native Time concept to the new carrier receipts. Re-run one exact semantic finance/shell query at two bounded information frontiers: T0 before the v2 terminal receipt envelope existed, and T1 after the v2 route/provider envelope was observed. The T0 view must retain exactly the coordinates knowable then; later route/provider metadata may appear only in the T1 derivation or an explicit later FactDelta/lineage edge, never silently rewrite historical evidence. Unknown model_ref must remain unknown at both times unless a real source later binds it. Use the current canonical Time/information-policy owner; BonfyreTime is the named public Power only if routed lawfully. Compare the two normalized outputs and emit a minimal temporal delta: added facts, invalidated derivations, unchanged semantic identities, and proof locality. This turns time itself into a communication dimension and tests the shoring law that new knowledge should invalidate/rederive the smallest necessary surface.
